results.title: Promised Hearts
results.overview: A young woman's future is jeopardized by a secret arrangement that throws her life into chaos — but it may be the only way to save her family.

results.title: Chupacabra vs. La Llorona
results.overview: A family struggles to survive when they are trapped in a country house with The Chupacabra lurking outside. However, chaos spirals when La Llorona is summoned to kill.

results.title: Cierva
results.overview: An emerging photographer is forced to make a crucial decision while on a career-defining job.

results.title: Dimension 20 Live: Battle at the Bowl
results.original_title: Dimension 20 Live: Battle at the Bowl
results.overview: The Bad Kids face-off against Chungledown Bim one last time in this canon live show event.

results.title: Do You Fear What I Fear?
results.original_title: Do You Fear What I Fear?
results.overview: When Claire lands her dream job in the city, she thinks she’s finally escaped her picture-perfect Christmas hometown. But her fresh start turns chilling when eerie holiday decorations begin appearing in her apartment… each one a message from someone who knows her too well. Who is the dangerous ‘Secret Santa’ watching her? Is it her charming new neighbor? The ex who won’t let go? To find out, Claire will have to turn the tables and set a trap of her own.

results.title: Fight for Tomorrow
results.overview: Former mob leader Shi Sanburo is released from prison and works as a car parker while trying to start a small pub business. One day, Sanburo is caught and sees his son in the police station. Knowing that he has stirred up troubles with gangsters, Sanburo tries to resolve the problem. Never would he expect the leader to be the son of his once triad brother, who double-crossed him and put him in jail. The sons will now fight at the Boxing Championship, bearing the conflicts of their own and the histories of their fathers. Chan Tai-lee, director of Tomorrow Is Another Day[14th], explores a troubled father-son relationship this time, driven by a compelling performance from veteran actor Patrick Tam.

results.title: The Empty House
results.overview: In this pseudo-vintage short, silent film based on the story by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, a woman and her nephew pay a visit to a supposedly haunted house.

results.title: Hoy no espero a nadie
results.overview: After using a stripper app, Guillo, a handsome dancer who was also Pedro's classmate in high school, arrives at Pedro's house. Embarrassed by what people will say, Pedro will try to convince Guillo that he really asked for a dancer, but after a couple of glasses of wine, the situation will get out of control.

results.title: Lui, L'autre, Moi et Un de trop
results.original_title: Lui, L'autre, Moi et Un de trop

results.title: My Everything
results.overview: While struggling to process his grief and resist thoughts of suicide, Barry sets out to avenge his wife's death by confronting the man who shot her.​

results.title: Petrichor
results.overview: A sweet, faithful Christian finds herself drawn to a new openly lesbian woman in her Bible study, forcing her to either challenge her learned homophobia or risk burying her own hidden identity forever.

results.title: Singing in My Sleep
results.overview: A brilliant teenage songwriter is stuck living in the shadow of her deceased Dad's music legacy when the 20-year anniversary of his debut album forces her to face his abandonment.

results.title: My Grandfather Is a Nihonjin
results.overview: Noboru is a 10-year-old boy in search of his cultural identity. He turns to his grandfather Hideo, to find out more about his family. Despite always avoiding his past, his grandfather agrees to tell his story. As Noboru delves into his family history, he discovers he has an uncle he’s never heard about.

results.title: Catrina
results.overview: Eight stories related to Death, who is a corporeal character in this film, an excuse to talk about the relativity of loss, love at first sight, the ridiculousness of rituals, and unfulfilled dreams.

results.title: Fair Companion
results.overview: Two cousins, Jean and Estelle, meet up for a walk. They're happy to see each other, but it's a strange year: whole swathes of the forest have been cut down and the paths have disappeared. Soon, a young man who had been sleeping under the trees crosses their path. He brings the sun with him.

results.title: To Our Friends
results.overview: An intimate documentary exploring friendship, resilience, and love among a group of young people in Madrid. Through a cinéma vérité approach, the film captures their struggles, aspirations, and moments of joy amid economic uncertainty. A central thread follows Sara, who falls in love with another woman, navigating the excitement and vulnerability of new love. Her journey of self-discovery unfolds organically, adding depth to the film’s broader themes of identity and connection. With its raw, unscripted storytelling, To Our Friends offers a poignant look at contemporary urban life and the enduring bonds that sustain us.

results.title: Delicates
results.overview: After a breakup, Colin loses a sock at the laundromat and discovers a psychic connection with its new owner.

results.title: Turn of the Tide: The Surreal Story of Rabo de Peixe
results.original_title: Maré Branca: A Surreal História de Rabo de Peixe
results.overview: In June 2001, hundreds of kilos of cocaine washed up in a Portuguese village. This gripping documentary reveals the long-lasting impact on the community.

results.title: Yves Ciampi: The Adventurer
results.overview: An atypical and little-known filmmaker, Yves Ciampi nevertheless left his mark on French cinema. Sébastien Le Pajolec and Pascal-Alex Vincent, university lecturers, along with Delphine Ciampi, musician and daughter of the filmmaker, paint a portrait of him interspersed with excerpts and previously unseen archive footage.

results.title: Про людей и про войну
results.overview: The Great Patriotic War. Ordinary situations cannot seriously influence the course of the global world conflict, which unfolded on thousands of kilometers of the front of a vast country, in which tens of millions of soldiers are participating. But it was the human qualities of everyone who stood to the death with weapons in their hands in this harsh time, where all the forces of good and evil came together, and everyone was ready to do anything for the sake of victory, that became the force that crushed Nazism.
